about: Hi! My name is Leonel Mujica and I am a Software engineer with experience in designing, implementing, and testing web and mobile applications. I am a lifelong learner with a passion for exploring different topics, including culture, technology, science, sports, and music.

As a software engineer, I take great pleasure in building and developing technology-based solutions that can make a positive impact on society. Throughout my career, I have gained expertise in automated testing, quality assurance, and test automation frameworks. I am skilled in using a range of tools and technologies to ensure the highest quality standards for software products.

I am excited about connecting with other professionals in the industry and exploring new opportunities to contribute my skills and knowledge. Please feel free to reach out to me if you would like to discuss potential collaborations or opportunities. Thank you for visiting my profile!
